overview.about: The Genesis Scottish Open is a flagship event co-sanctioned by the PGA Tour and the DP World Tour, played at The Renaissance Club on Scotland's east coast the week before The Open. Its links-style test is ideal preparation for the year's oldest major, and it now draws one of the strongest fields in European golf.
overview.nextEvent: The next Genesis Scottish Open is played at The Renaissance Club in North Berwick, Scotland. Co-sanctioned by the PGA and DP World Tours, it pairs a top-class field with links conditions ahead of The Open.
